title: Governance Standard
description: A `Governance Standard` entity represents a specific rule, requirement, or guideline that implements a Governance Policy. Each standard belongs to a parent Governance Policy.

id.description: Unique identifier of this governance standard instance.

name.description: A unique name that identifies the governance standard within its parent policy.

displayName.description: Display Name that identifies this governance standard.

parent.description: Reference to the parent Governance Policy that contains this standard.

updatedAt.description: Last update time corresponding to the new version of the entity in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

impersonatedBy.description: Bot user that performed the action on behalf of the actual user.

href.description: Link to the resource corresponding to this governance standard.

tags.description: Tags associated with this governance standard.

changeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

incrementalChangeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

deleted.description: When `true` indicates the entity has been soft deleted.

extension.description: Entity extension data with custom attributes added to the entity.

provider.description: Provider type for this governance standard (system or user).
